tcs.summary: EN: Verify model DM_techmovie_dsr exists with exactly the 7 spec fields, types, required flags and defaults. JP: DM_techmovie_dsrモデルが仕様の7項目（型・必須・初期値）で存在することを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: Author cookie valid. JP: Authorクッキー有効。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Read-only: node tools/author/author.mjs models. 2. Read model /conf/ykk/settings/dam/cfm/models/dm_techmovie_dsr (title, fields). JP: モデル定義を取得。
tcs.expected: EN: Title DM_techmovie_dsr. Fields in order: movieLabel (single line text, optional), movie (fragment reference single, REQUIRED), dsrFeatures (tag, multiple), isBoothLimited (boolean, default false), relatedArticles (content reference multiple), relatedLandingPages (content reference multiple), isActive / 表示フラグ (boolean, default false, REQUIRED). No other field. JP: 7項目、movie・isActive必須、初期値false。

assumptions: Baseline BL-670-1 = DSR-670 description (Model spec table, Scope, Acceptance criteria, Out of scope; Jira 23/10). Deploy dev/2026.10.23_2 b33514f (KNOWN-FACTS).

Observation JOB-20261023-21 (models-after.md): on DEV the model shows isActive NOT required, while the spec table marks it required (○). TC 1.0 keeps the spec as expected; a mismatch on run = Fail candidate (bug confidence decided on result).
[Giả định] 'Same content as before' (AC3) cannot be compared: DEV had no tech-talk CF before 670 (Martin report). Oracle = standard video page layout (same template cf-templates/video.html).

[Giả định] Tech talk inactive / booth / unavailable behaviour = same as standard video (AC4 'same as standard videos'); standard inactive = 200 + unavailable row, browser redirect to list, noindex (KNOWN-FACTS 22/10 Martin).
Naming / directory-strict rules of BL-OVL-1 apply to tech talks (URL = DSR CF node name, lowercase/digits/'-').
Test data qa670-* are created by lane author/chrome (QA-owned, ja only); content CF and DSR CF share the node name. cn: no /cn on DEV (Issue #18).
Tech talk list is out of scope (DSR-670); 14.0 only checks the standard list is not polluted.

howto: Content CF: open https://author-p192812-e2014374.adobeaemcloud.com/assets.html/content/dam/common/ja/movies → Create → Content Fragment → DM_movie → Name = id in Data sheet (lowercase exactly, e.g. qa670-tech) → fill EVERY required field: movieId (= Name, exactly), movieTitle, description, thumbnail, movieSource = youtube, publishDate 2026-10-24; plus movieSourceId (copy from common/ja/movies/qa587-main) → Create → Save → Publish.
movieId ≠ Name is the most frequent error (QA-PT-ERRORS) – check before Publish.

DSR CF: open https://author-p192812-e2014374.adobeaemcloud.com/assets.html/content/dam/dsr/ja/movies/tech → Create → Content Fragment → DM_techmovie_dsr (expected only choice; screenshot = TC 3.0) → Name = same id → 対象動画 (movie) = pick /content/dam/common/ja/movies/<id> → check movieLabel autofill (TC 5.0) → 表示フラグ as in Data sheet → Save → Publish.
Folder movies/tech missing → Note 'no tech folder', stop TD-670. DM_techmovie_dsr not offered → TC 3.0 Fail, stop.
TD-670-03: set ブース限定掲載 ON and pick 1 booth tag in DSR掲載ブース before Save. TD-670-04: set 配信終了フラグ ON in the CONTENT CF (step 1) before Publish.
Booth tag list empty → Note, skip TD-670-03.
After publishing, wait ≥ 5 min, then open https://main--dsr-eds-dev--sutrix-projects.aem.live/ja/library/video/tech-talk/<id> once and write HTTP status + UTC time in the result.
404 after 10 min → Note 'page not generated' (= TC 8.0 Fail candidate).
TC 6.0 revert: after the Save attempt, set ブース限定掲載 OFF and close WITHOUT saving; if saved by mistake → OFF, Save, Publish, write it in the result.
